chunks: 4922 - Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said: I heard him saying:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله returned from a military expedition in which many of the Muslims had been struck down. The women came out to meet him, asking about their slain ones. A woman came near him and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what happened to so-and-so?' He said, 'And what is he to you?' She said, 'My brother.' He said:
Praise Allah and say the words of return, for he has been martyred.
So she did that. Then she said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what happened to so-and-so?' He said, 'And what is he to you?' She said, 'My husband.' He said:
Praise Allah and say the words of return, for he has been martyred.
Then she said, 'Oh, what humiliation!' So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said, 'I did not think that a woman would feel this much over her husband until I saw this woman.'

key_terms.قَتْلَاهُنَّ: their slain relatives or loved ones
key_terms.وَاسْتَرْجِعِي: say the formula of return to Allah at calamity

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about a woman's grief for her martyred husband?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an incident after a military expedition in which many Muslims were martyred, showing how women came to ask the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله about their slain relatives. It highlights the depth of a wife's grief for her husband and preserves a Prophetic observation about the intensity of spousal attachment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4922 - Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"I heard him say: 
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) returned from a military expedition in which many Muslims had been killed. The women came to meet him, asking about their slain relatives.
A woman approached him and said: 'O Messenger of Allah (swt), what happened to so-and-so?'
He (sw) replied: 'And what is he to you?'
She said: 'He is my brother.'
He (sw) said: 'Praise Allah (swt) and say Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un (Indeed, we belong to Allah (swt) and to Him we shall return), for he has been martyred.'
She did so and then asked: 'O Messenger of Allah (swt), what about so-and-so?'
He (sw) said: 'And what is he to you?'
She said: 'He is my husband.'
He (sw) said: 'Praise Allah (swt) and say Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, for he has been martyred.'
She then exclaimed, 'Oh, what a tragedy!'
The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I never thought a woman would feel such grief over her husband until I saw this woman.'"
